dataset: Original T2D Gold Standard correspondence metadata
scope: Induced annotation-only schema lookup: original annotated source columns versus the union of annotated property URIs for their class. These target vocabularies are constructed from annotations, not independently supplied real target schemas. No raw tables, samples, inferred types, hints, corroboration or review constraints.
partition_rule: SHA256(UTF-8 class URI).first_byte % 5 == 0 reserves the entire class as holdout; all other classes are development. No field/table-level random split. Class vocabularies use only that class's annotations, so no class crosses partitions; shared ontology properties may still occur across classes.
holdout_policy: RESERVED. This version of --external cannot score holdout. A later evaluation phase must freeze its implementation and protocol before adding an explicit, verified holdout entry point.
labels: Only explicit source-index/property-URI correspondences are positive. Multiple positives for one source index form an acceptable set. All other target choices are unknown, never false positives or confirmed no-match. Empty annotation files supply no evaluable schema, and nonempty files missing a class are excluded; IDs and reasons are in the fixture.

metrics.known_positive_field_recall: Fields whose proposal matches any known-positive target / all annotated source fields, including fields in rejected inputs in the denominator.
metrics.known_positive_edge_recall_at_5: Distinct known-positive edges appearing in displayed top-5 candidates / all known-positive edges; candidates may be ineligible. Rejected inputs contribute zero hits.
metrics.unknown_proposals: Selected source/target edges not covered by a positive label; outcome unknown, not an error count.
metrics.abstentions: Successfully evaluated source fields with no proposal; not classified as correct or incorrect abstention.
metrics.input_rejections: Report each library input error explicitly with source-field count; no truncation, filtering, or silent omission.

interpretation: No precision, false-positive, unmatched-field, calibration, or production-accuracy claim is supported by these positive-only annotations. Classes/ontology properties are correlated and the class-derived target vocabulary is selected using the corpus labels. This is independent annotation evidence, not independent consumer validation. Compare fixed existing models descriptively; do not tune thresholds on development outcomes.
